_doc: Canonical v0 agent_tool_matrix shipped with the OSS template. The wizard's company-init step loads this verbatim into the per-company .juvant/state.db. Keep this file in lockstep with the table in agents/company/cto.md § Default Agent Tool Matrix — the table is the human reference, this JSON is the runtime source of truth. Drift between the two is detected by the matrix cross-check (see docs/MCP_INVENTORY.md and ADR 0011). Optional roles (cro, vpe) ship as rows here unconditionally; the wizard activates only those whose feature_toggles.<role>_enabled is true at company init. eng-platform is mandatory by default in v0.8.0 (feature_toggles.eng_platform_enabled defaults true) per ADR 0016 — the framework is software-development-flavored. cloud:write is an abstract MCP entry resolved at adoption time per feature_toggles.cloud_provider ∈ {azure, aws, gcp, none}; with cloud_provider=none the cloud:write entry is dropped from eng-platform's row.
_provenance: Schema 1 baseline: drift-corrected from tests/fixtures/matrix/2026-05-09-golf-corrected.json (F-12, v0.6.6). Schema 2 amendments: role-identifier rename per ADR 0014 §1 (ca→cto, project cto→pca, coo→eng-lead, cdo→design-lead, cpo→product-lead); project-VPE removed per ADR 0014 §2 (absorbed by Eng Lead at project scope); company-VPE added as toggle-gated optional row per ADR 0014 §2; eng-platform capability expansion per ADR 0014 §3 (github:write at company scope, cloud:write, npm:publish). Lands in v0.8.0. Schema 3 amendment (FEAT-052, v1.8.0): github:read/github:write MCP capabilities removed from every row — GitHub access is now via the gh CLI (timeout-wrapped with helpers/with-timeout.sh), governed by the Bash allow-list plus the Track-2d single-writer gate for gh writes (eng-lead/eng-platform only). The deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-github MCP is dropped.

rows.rationale: Orchestrator; proxies CEO ↔ agents; sends Critical alerts to CEO via the :send-ceo-only carve-out (ADR 0011).
Banking + financial docs + Italian e-invoicing (pending FEAT-012); mail-enabled (finance@).
Legal docs + contracts; mail-enabled (legal@).

Brand + scheduled posting; mail-enabled (press@). Owns company brand identity, voice/tone codification, brand architecture (see ADR 0015 §1); validates project brand-spec rows in inherit/extend modes and advises (without veto) in independent mode.
Sales + partnerships; mail-enabled (hello@).
Internal HR; ranking + manifesto + offboarding.
5-layer audits; investigates security_audit_log.
Ethics framework; validates disclosure policies.

Owns agent_tool_matrix; cross-project tech standards; architectural-principle citation chain (§7); read-only github across all repos. Renamed from `ca` per ADR 0014 §1 — the project-scope CTO that previously existed is now `pca`.
Optional company-scope role gated by feature_toggles.cro_enabled (default false). Research synthesis; reads SharePoint/OneDrive; produces durable knowledge_base entries with citations.

Optional company-scope role gated by feature_toggles.vpe_enabled (default false). Cross-project Eng/* aggregator: weekly engineering health report across all projects, cross-project release coordination, cross-project Tier-4 disclosure-cascade fallback recipient. SKIP for single-project shops — the company `cto` performs cross-project aggregation directly when N=1. Per ADR 0014 §2; replaces the per-project VPE that existed in v0.7.x.

Mandatory company-scope role by default (gated by feature_toggles.eng_platform_enabled, default true per ADR 0016). Sole writer at company scope (§4 single-writer-per-scope, ADR 0014): company-level repos (template fork, *-infra at company scope, shared-services-infra, canonical-helpers source repos), the cloud control plane (azure/aws/gcp/turso resolved at adoption per feature_toggles.cloud_provider), and npm registry for canonical-helper publication (FEAT-024). Authors pr-spec at company scope (executes self), pr-spec at project scope (routes to project's Eng Lead), eng-platform-spec (new class introduced in ADR 0014 §5; author=executor with CTO as approver-of-record), install-spec (shared with cto), branch-protection-spec at company scope (shared with cso + cto). Project repos are READ-ONLY; cross-scope writes are forbidden.

Project Chief Architect — per-project technical leadership within company tech standards set by `cto`. Sole Tier 1 manifesto approver for project-scope agents (ADR 0014 §6). Read-only github; PR specs route to the project's eng-lead. Renamed from project-scope `cto` per ADR 0014 §1 to disambiguate from the company-scope CTO.

Product Lead — per-project product direction, PRD authorship, GitHub issue/project/milestone spec authoring (executed by eng-lead). Renamed from `cpo` per ADR 0014 §1 (the chief-product framing belongs at company scope when needed).

Design Lead — per-project design system, project visual identity (subject to brand-spec mode per ADR 0015), UX research, accessibility. Authors brand-spec rows at project scope; cmo validates inherit/extend modes, advises independent mode (CEO ratifies independent mode once per brand). Renamed from `cdo` per ADR 0014 §1 to remove the Chief-Data-Officer collision.

Engineering Lead — sole writer at project scope (§4 single-writer-per-scope, ADR 0014): executes pr-spec / gh-issue-spec / gh-project-update-spec / gh-milestone-spec / install-spec / release-spec / deployment-spec / branch-protection-spec / secret-rotation-spec authored by peer agents. Owns operational health (deployments, runbooks, incident response, branch protection, releases). Day-to-day Eng/* delegation authority + per-task Eng/* model override authority (absorbed from the project-VPE that existed in v0.7.x; ADR 0014 §2). Renamed from `coo` per ADR 0014 §1 — the role is engineering execution, not generic operations.
API engineering; receives delegations from project's eng-lead.
Backend + data-layer engineering; receives delegations from project's eng-lead.
Frontend engineering; consumes design system canonical in knowledge_base; receives delegations from project's eng-lead.
AI/ML engineering; receives delegations from project's eng-lead.
